name: DP Cheesesteaks (American Fork / Lehi, UT) Grilled Chicken & Provolone ("Wiz Witout")
whyItWorks: Freshly sliced chicken breast chopped on the flat-top with melted provolone cheese on a soft Amoroso-style Italian roll. 'Witout' ordering omits fried onions completely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Cheesesteak with provolone cheese 'Witout' (meaning no onions) and no hot peppers.
watchOuts: Specify 'Witout' so no fried onions or peppers are added to the grill
